craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-vīra of the cremation ground — Rauhine register throughout: broken-middle-drunk → gore teaches → brow burns → sky speaks → parted freed. Those-two-these duals per UNC (tau/imau); lotus-skulls as-it-were; great-Time. Rejected: (a) leveling duals → killed by UNC. Read aloud: PRIDE-heart-BOND up-ROOT-ers … HELD by-YOU, GREAT-time.

lines: Pride-heart-bond uprooters — those two, these crested embodied —
lotus-skulls as it were — showing, held by You, great Time.
l4.sanskrit_cite: abhimānahṛdayabandhānutkhātau tāv imau saśikhau mūrtāv iva muṇdābjau prathayan dhatse mahākālaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What holds skull-lotuses? → Uprooters tufted lotus-held showing.
c1_essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.
